references.text: Here we see how the Spirit of the Lord came upon David, in the same way that Jesus was filled with the Holy Spirit.
This verse prophesies that the Messiah will be filled with the Lord's Spirit, which is fulfilled in Jesus in Luke 4:1.
This refers to Jesus' baptism, where he receives the Holy Spirit, which is a prerequisite for the event in Luke 4:1.
This is a parallel event where Jesus, filled with the Holy Spirit, is led out into the wilderness, just as in Luke.
